Title: Remove weak JWT secret fallback
Description: Fail startup if JWT_SECRET is missing or weak; remove default secret fallback from auth runtime.

Title: Fix refresh token revocation gap
Description: Check refresh-token blocklist during refresh and prepare for jti/session-based rotation.

Title: Remove global plaintext broker token flow
Description: Retire .access_token live runtime dependency and remove hardcoded request token flow.

Title: Move server test helpers out of production build
Description: Move SQLite/testing helpers to _test.go or internal/testutil so server build graph stays production-only.

Title: Remove destructive market_data migration pattern
Description: Replace DROP TABLE behavior with forward-only production-safe migration logic.

Title: Introduce App and RuntimeManager
Description: Create explicit application bootstrap and service lifecycle manager with start/stop/status ownership.

Title: Eliminate server package globals
Description: Replace Set* global dependency injection in server package with constructor-based dependency structs.

Title: Split overloaded server package
Description: Separate HTTP API, realtime transport, and runtime composition responsibilities.

Title: Define canonical normalized tick event model
Description: Separate event_time and ingested_at, decide canonical stored tick shape, and reduce ambiguity in raw event truth.

Title: Fix ingest channel ownership and loss semantics
Description: Make service owner close channels and stop silently dropping authoritative tick batches under pressure.

Title: Redesign candle bucket alignment and finalization
Description: Use session-relative event-time alignment and decouple candle close from next tick arrival.

Title: Separate open candle state from finalized candle persistence
Description: Ensure incomplete candles are never stored as final trading truth.

Title: Implement ReplayManager
Description: Rebuild candles deterministically from persisted ticks after restart or recovery.

Title: Add late and out-of-order tick policy
Description: Detect, classify, and repair or quarantine late ticks for finalized buckets.

Title: Replace full-history recalculation with incremental state
Description: Maintain per-indicator rolling state and remove goroutine-per-indicator pattern.

Title: Optimize indicator warm-start hydration
Description: Load only bounded recent finalized candles per token/interval and validate continuity.

Title: Separate indicator engine persistence and broadcast
Description: Do not broadcast authoritative indicator updates before persistence semantics are defined.

Title: Build authenticated unified websocket hub
Description: Create one websocket entrypoint with topic subscriptions, auth, and per-client queue policies.

Title: Retire ad hoc websocket endpoints
Description: Replace /ws, /ws/candles, /ws/indicators, and /ws/heatmap with unified typed event fanout.

Title: Adopt shared websocket envelope everywhere
Description: Ensure all realtime messages use contracts.WSEvent with consistent topic and event IDs.

Title: Introduce broker adapter abstraction
Description: Define broker-agnostic provider interfaces and isolate Zerodha-specific session logic.

Title: Implement per-user broker connect callback disconnect flows
Description: Use encrypted tokens in user_broker_accounts and bind all broker state to user and account identity.

Title: Write audit events for auth and broker actions
Description: Start using audit_events table for login, logout, refresh, connect, callback, and disconnect flows.

Title: Create strategy runtime core
Description: Add strategy registry, runner, parameter loading, and event-driven strategy interface.

Title: Create risk service and kill switch
Description: Enforce daily loss, quantity, market-open, live-mode guardrails, and global/user kill switches.

Title: Create execution service with idempotency
Description: Accept TradeIntent, require risk approval, persist lifecycle, and separate paper vs live adapters.

Title: Create PnL service
Description: Implement realized and unrealized PnL, per-user and per-strategy attribution, and mark-to-market updates.

Title: Implement paper broker and paper-trading mode
Description: Use same strategy and execution pipeline with simulated fills, fees, and slippage.

Title: Implement backtest service and command
Description: Reuse strategy runtime and paper execution path for offline backtests and stored job results.

Title: Centralize REST response helpers and validation errors
Description: Use one response writer path and make validation return contracts.ErrorResponse consistently.

Title: Reconcile OpenAPI with actual implementation
Description: Make one source-of-truth spec and mark planned endpoints separately from implemented ones.

Title: Rename and simplify misleading files and packages
Description: Rename candels.go, rename monitor package under execution, and reduce misleading placeholder surface area.

Title: Prune placeholder-only packages and dead commented code
Description: Collapse doc-only packages where implementation has not started and archive or delete commented-out news pipeline.

Title: Apply auth and API rate limits"
Description: Use existing limiter on auth and later on sensitive runtime and broker routes.

Title: Add secure Redis and Postgres transport options
Description: Make SSL/TLS and secure connection options configurable and validated at boot.

Title: Add real operational metrics and queue-depth visibility
Description: Track drops, queue depths, replay lag, service readiness, and execution/risk outcomes.

Title: Create model registry and inference activation controls
Description: Separate model metadata, active versions, and safe inference consumption from runtime internals.

Title: Prepare RL-safe replay environment
Description: Only after deterministic replay and paper execution exist, define environment state, rewards, and action logs for PPO/A3C experimentation.
